say.111521: one hundred eleven thousand, five hundred twenty-one

scenes.name: THE GROUND
lines: Chapter two averaged over infinitely many zeros. What can one finite window give?
第二章在无穷多枚零点上取平均。一个有限的窗口，究竟能给出什么？
First, the ground: RH and Dirichlet GRH have an external Lean proof, by Levent Alpöge.
先看地基：RH 与狄利克雷 GRH 如今有了 Levent Alpöge 的外部 Lean 证明。
It is not frozen in the pinned library, so it never wears green.
它尚未冻结进所钉的库，所以从不佩戴绿色徽章。
It covers only zeta and Dirichlet L functions, nothing in physics. Grand RH stays open.
它只管 ζ 函数与狄利克雷 L 函数，不涉物理；全广义黎曼猜想仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LINE INTO CIRCLE
lines: Lean restates RH twice.
Lean 把 RH 改写了两次。
First as a circle: the Cayley map lands on the unit circle exactly when the real part is one half.
第一次改写成圆：凯莱映射落在单位圆上，当且仅当实部是二分之一。
So RH says every nontrivial zero lands on the circle.
于是 RH 说：每一枚非平凡零点都落在圆上。
Then as a gap: RH holds exactly when the prime remainder stays c log squared below M root x, for all c under a forty-eighth.
第二次改写成差额：RH 成立，当且仅当对每个 c < 1/48，曼戈尔特余项最终比 M√x 低出 c(log x)²。

scenes.name: PHASES FALL SHORT
lines: Weight each zero height gamma harmonically, and add the phases at time t.
给每个零点高度 γ 配上调和权，再把时刻 t 的相位加起来。
Z reaches length one only when every phase lines up.
Z 的长度只有在所有相位对齐时才能达到 1。
Under RH, Lean bounds the shortfall near one over T by a constant over a power of log T.
在 RH 前提下，Lean 给亏损定下界：在 1/T 附近，下界是常数除以 log T 的幂。
Out to log T, given a Landau envelope, it is at least one over 32 log T.
一直到 log T，在兰道包络的前提下，亏损至少是 1/(32 log T)。

scenes.name: ONE OVER ROOT PI
lines: That envelope needs a Landau contour around the zeros.
这个包络需要一个圈住零点的兰道围道。
Lean bounds its two vertical edges with explicit constants, and needs no RH for that.
Lean 用显式常数界住它的两条竖边，这一步不需要 RH。
With the top edge they give the envelope; that step is argued, not cited.
接上顶边就得到包络；这一步只是论证，未作引用。
Stitch the windows, and Lean checks that the scaled near-collision count tends to one over root pi.
把各时间窗拼起来，Lean 检验：近碰撞的归一化计数趋于 1/√π。

scenes.name: ZERO 11431
lines: Now one window: zero 11431, nine neighbours on each side.
现在看一个窗口：第 11431 枚零点，左右各九枚邻居。
Of three thousand centres, it sits nearest a midpoint: within two millionths.
在三千个中心里，它最贴近一个中点：误差在百万分之二以内。
The runner-up is 35.6 times worse; the extra pair holds under a quarter of the fourth moment.
次优者差了 35.6 倍；这组额外配对只占四阶矩不到四分之一。
At resolution one thousandth, it first shows up at radius 111521. Certificates, not theorems.
分辨率取千分之一，它在半径 111521 处首次显现。是证书，不是定理。

scenes.name: THREE WINDOWS
lines: Later volumes ask one zero to pass three windows at once.
后面几卷要求单枚零点同时通过三扇窗。
With the cut fixed at nine, zero 8359 passes all three first.
分界固定为 9 时，第 8359 枚最先三窗全通。
With the shell's own site-variance cut, zero 8236 gets in first.
换成球壳自身的站点方差分界，第 8236 枚抢先过关。
But the inputs are chosen. A window hit is not a prediction.
但这些输入都是选定的。命中窗口不是预言。

scenes.name: THE HONEST GAP
lines: Here is the gap: every Lean bound here is an average up to T.
缺口就在这里：这里每一条 Lean 界都是截至 T 的平均。
The shell reads one zero, or a handful. No comparison theorem bridges the two yet.
球壳读取的却是一枚零点、或寥寥几枚。连接两者的比较定理至今还没有。
Higher up, almost every centre beats 11431. Averages are welded; selection is open.
更高处，几乎每个中心都胜过第 11431 枚。平均已焊死，选点仍开放。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter three.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第三章
